What every guide helps you do

Check your listing

Make sure people can understand who you are, where you serve and how to contact you.

Make the next step clear

Help a potential customer know what to do next without making promises you cannot support.

Create useful local content

Prepare educational, offer or community-participation ideas that you can review before using.

Plan local participation

Find responsible ways to participate in Franklin events, organizations and community needs.

Measure real progress

Track completed improvements separately from leads, customers and revenue.

Stay trustworthy

Payment never changes factual accuracy, credentials, safety information or ordinary directory placement.

What is free and what is planned?

Checking your basic listing and preparing a factual correction are free. The Business Growth Planner and these guides are also free to use today. Membership enrollment is currently closed. Free planning tools remain available. If sponsored placements are offered later, they will be clearly labeled and will not change ordinary directory placement. No guide or plan can guarantee leads, customers or revenue.
